analysis.executive_summary: Documentation audit of docs.dyte.io crawled 1220 pages with 100% coverage across 1225 discovered pages. Critical issue: 712 confirmed broken internal documentation links affecting user navigation. API reference coverage is low at 30.95% across 187 detected API pages. Freshness is strong with 90.74% of pages showing last-updated metadata. SEO/geo issues affect 15.31% of content, indicating potential discoverability problems.
strengths: Complete crawl coverage at 100% (1220 of 1225 pages within scope)
High freshness coverage at 90.74% with last-updated metadata present
Strong example reliability at 89.2% across code samples
High overall confidence score of 91.39% for audit findings
No repository navigation link breakage (0 repo_broken_links_count)
risks: 712 broken internal documentation links create severe navigation and user experience degradation
API reference coverage at 30.95% leaves 69% of API surface undocumented or poorly linked
SEO/geo issue rate of 15.31% may reduce organic discoverability and search ranking
768 trap URLs skipped suggests potential crawler confusion or URL structure issues
2 unverified links due to auth/rate-limit/server blocks may hide additional broken links
Low API reference coverage across 187 API pages indicates incomplete technical documentation
Large gap between requested pages (2125) and crawled pages (1220) suggests access or structure barriers

prioritized_actions.action: Audit and repair 712 broken internal documentation links to restore navigation integrity
Expand API reference documentation from 30.95% to minimum 80% coverage across 187 API pages
Resolve SEO/geo issues affecting 15.31% of pages to improve search discoverability
